mapper.update: UPDATE /* isry.itgcm.crtrinfo.resrce.SrvcResrceMapper.updateResrceProgrmInstr(자원프로그램강사수정) */ SDA342 T1 /* 프로그램강사 */ SET T1.PCHPRS_YN = NVL(#{PCHPRS_YN},'N') -- 강사종사자번호 , T1.DEL_YN = NVL(#{DEL_YN},'N') -- 삭제여부 , T1.COMPNO_INSTR_YN = #{COMPNO_INSTR_YN} -- 복수강사여부 , T1.LAST_MDFR_ID = #{SESS_USER_ID} -- 최종수정자아이디 , T1.LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE -- 최종수정일시 WHERE T1.PROGRM_NO = #{PROGRM_NO} -- 프로그램번호 AND T1.RESRCE_NO = #{RESRCE_NO} -- 자원번호 AND T1.LCTRE_SN = #{LCTRE_SN} -- 강의일련번호 AND T1.INSTR_ENFSN_NO = #{INSTR_ENFSN_NO} -- 강사종사자번호

UPDATE /* isry.itgcm.crtrinfo.resrce.SrvcResrceMapper.deleteResrceProgrmInstr(자원프로그램강사삭제) */ SDA342 T1 /* 프로그램강사 */ SET T1.DEL_YN = 'Y' -- 삭제여부 , T1.LAST_MDFR_ID = #{SESS_USER_ID} -- 최종수정자아이디 , T1.LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE -- 최종수정일시 WHERE T1.PROGRM_NO = #{PROGRM_NO} -- 프로그램번호 AND T1.RESRCE_NO = #{RESRCE_NO} -- 자원번호 AND T1.LCTRE_SN = #{LCTRE_SN} -- 강의일련번호 AND T1.INSTR_ENFSN_NO = #{INSTR_ENFSN_NO} -- 강사종사자번호

UPDATE /* isry.itgcm.crtrinfo.resrce.SrvcResrceMapper.updateAprvPrcs(자원 승인(반려)처리) */ SDA100 T1 /* 자원기본 */ SET T1.APRV_DT = TO_DATE(#{APRV_DT},'YYYYMMDD HH24MISS') -- 승인일시 , T1.APRV_STTS_SE_CD = #{APRV_STTS_SE_CD} -- 승인상태구분코드 , T1.AUTZR_NO = #{AUTZR_NO} -- 승인자번호 , T1.APRV_CN = #{APRV_CN} -- 승인내용 , T1.RJCT_CS_CN = #{RJCT_CS_CN} -- 반려사유내용 , T1.LAST_MDFR_ID = #{SESS_USER_ID} -- 최종수정자아이디 , T1.LAST_MDFCN_DT = SYSDATE -- 최종수정일시 WHERE T1.RESRCE_NO = #{RESRCE_NO} -- 자원번호
mapper.select: /* isry.itgcm.crtrinfo.resrce.SrvcResrceMapper.selectBizYrCombo1(사업연도 콤보 데이터 조회) */ SELECT DISTINCT BIZ_YR /* 사업연도 */ FROM SDA400 A /* 서비스사업 */ WHERE 1=1 AND A.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} ORDER BY BIZ_YR DESC

SELECT /* isry.itgcm.crtrinfo.resrce.SrvcResrceMapper.selectResrceNmCombo(교육과정 콤보 데이터 조회) */ T1.RESRCE_NO AS RESRCE_NO /* 자원번호 */ , T1.PVSN_RESRCE_NM AS PVSN_RESRCE_NM /* 자원제공명 */ , T1.RSFR_INST_NO AS INST_NO /* 자원제공주체번호 */ , ( SELECT BIZ_YR FROM SDA400 /* 서비스사업 */ WHERE SRVC_BIZ_NO = ( SELECT SRVC_BIZ_NO FROM SDA420 /* 서비스실행사업 */ WHERE SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = T1.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO) ) AS BIZ_YR /* 사업연도 */ , T1.SRVC_RESRCE_LCLAS_SE_CD /* 서비스자원대분류구분코드 */ FROM SDA100 T1 /* 자원기본 */ , SAA000 T2 /* 통합기관 */ WHERE T1.RSFR_INST_NO LIKE T2.INST_NO(+) AND T2.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} AND (T2.INST_NO = #{INST_NO} OR T2.UP_INST_NO = #{INST_NO} OR #{INST_TYPE_SE_CD} = '4' OR #{INST_TYPE_SE_CD} = '1') AND T1.SRVC_TYPE_SE_CD = '04' --04:프로그램 AND T1.USE_YN = 'Y' AND T2.DEL_YN = 'N' AND T1.APRV_STTS_SE_CD IN ('1', '2')

SELECT /* isry.itgcm.crtrinfo.resrce.SrvcResrceMapper.selectInstNmCombo(교육기관 콤보 데이터 조회) */ T1.INST_TYPE_SE_CD AS INST_TYPE_SE_CD /* 기관유형구분코드 */ FROM SAA000 T1 /* 통합기관 */ WHERE 1=1 AND T1.INST_NO = #{INST_NO} AND T1.DEL_YN = 'N'

SELECT /* isry.itgcm.crtrinfo.resrce.SrvcResrceMapper.selectInstNmCombo1(교육기관 콤보 데이터 조회) */ T1.INST_NO AS INST_NO /* 기관번호 */ , T1.INST_NM AS INST_NM /* 기관명 */ , T1.INST_TYPE_SE_CD AS INST_TYPE_SE_CD /* 기관유형구분코드 */ FROM SAA000 T1 /* 통합기관 */ WHERE 1=1 AND T1.INST_NO = #{INST_NO} AND T1.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY T1.INST_NM

SELECT /* isry.itgcm.crtrinfo.resrce.SrvcResrceMapper.selectInstNmCombo2(교육기관 콤보 데이터 조회2) */ T1.INST_NO AS INST_NO /* 기관번호 */ , T1.INST_NM AS INST_NM /* 기관명 */ , T1.INST_TYPE_SE_CD AS INST_TYPE_SE_CD /* 기관유형구분코드 */ FROM SAA000 T1 /* 통합기관 */ WHERE 1=1 AND T1.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{untTaskwk} AND T1.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY T1.INST_NM

SELECT /* isry.itgcm.crtrinfo.resrce.SrvcResrceMapper.selectInstNmCombo3(교육기관 콤보 데이터 조회3) */ T1.INST_NO AS INST_NO /* 기관번호 */ , T1.INST_NM AS INST_NM /* 기관명 */ , T1.INST_TYPE_SE_CD AS INST_TYPE_SE_CD /* 기관유형구분코드 */ FROM SAA000 T1 /* 통합기관 */ WHERE 1=1 AND T1.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{untTaskwkSeCd} AND T1.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY T1.INST_NM

/* selectInstNmCombo - Lee SangHoon */
SELECT A.INST_NO AS INST_NO ,A.INST_NM AS INST_NM ,MAX(SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH(A.BIZ_YR,'|')) AS BIZ_YR ,MAX(SYS_CONNECT_BY_PATH(A.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO,'|')) AS SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO ,'Y' AS FILTER FROM (SELECT A.INST_NO AS INST_NO /* 기관번호 */ ,A.INST_NM AS INST_NM /* 기관명 */ ,B.BIZ_YR AS BIZ_YR /* 사업연도 */ ,B.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO AS SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO /* 서비스실행사업번호*/ ,(ROW_NUMBER () OVER(PARTITION BY A.INST_NO ORDER BY A.INST_NO, B.BIZ_YR, B.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO )) RNUM FROM SAA000 A /* 통합기관 */
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT T1.BIZ_YR , T2.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO , T3.RSFR_INST_NO FROM SDA400 T1 JOIN SDA420 T2 ON T2.SRVC_BIZ_NO = T1.SRVC_BIZ_NO JOIN SDA100 T3 ON T3.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = T2.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO WHERE T3.APRV_STTS_SE_CD = '2' ) B ON B.RSFR_INST_NO = A.INST_NO
WHERE 1=1 AND (A.INST_NO = #{INST_NO} OR #{INST_TYPE_SE_CD} != '8') AND A.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.INST_TYPE_SE_CD = '8') A START WITH A.RNUM = 1 CONNECT BY PRIOR A.RNUM = (A.RNUM - 1) AND PRIOR A.INST_NO = A.INST_NO
GROUP BY A.INST_NO, A.INST_NM
ORDER BY A.INST_NO

SELECT /* isry.itgcm.crtrinfo.resrce.SrvcResrceMapper.selectDateList(프로그램 일자 구하기) */ MIN(PROGRM_YMD) AS MIN_DT ,MAX(PROGRM_YMD) AS MAX_DT ,SUM(LCTRE_HR) AS SUM_HR ,PROGRM_NM AS PROGRM_NM_NOW FROM SDA510 /* 엑셀업로드수업일정 */ WHERE 1=1 AND PROGRM_NM = #{PROGRM_NM} AND EDU_PROGRM_SE_CD = #{EDU_PROGRM_SE_CD} GROUP by PROGRM_NM ORDER BY MIN(PROGRM_YMD)

/* isry.itgcm.crtrinfo.resrce.SrvcResrceMapper.selectEduSchdlResourceList(스케쥴적용 자원프로그램 조회) */ SELECT a.PROGRM_NM AS PROGRM_NM ,MIN(a.PROGRM_YMD) AS MIN_DT ,MAX(a.PROGRM_YMD) AS MAX_DT ,SUM(a.LCTRE_HR) AS SUM_HR ,a.EDU_PROGRM_SE_CD AS EDU_PROGRM_SE_CD FROM SDA510 a /* 엑셀업로드수업일정 */ ,SDA511 b /* 엑셀업로드보조강사 */ WHERE 1=1 AND a.JOB_YMD = b.JOB_YMD AND a.OPRTR_ID = b.OPRTR_ID AND a.TMPR_SN = b.TMPR_SN AND a.RESRCE_NO = #{RESRCE_NO} AND b.PCHPRS_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY a.PROGRM_NM, a.EDU_PROGRM_SE_CD ORDER BY MIN(a.PROGRM_YMD)

/* isry.itgcm.crtrinfo.resrce.SrvcResrceMapper.selectEduSchdlResourceDtlList(스케쥴적용 자원프로그램상세 조회) */
SELECT A.PROGRM_NM , A.EDU_PROGRM_SE_CD , A.PROGRM_BGNG_HR , A.PROGRM_END_HR , SUM(A.LCTRE_HR) AS SUM_HR , B.COMPNO_INSTR_YN , B.ENFSN_NO , MIN(A.PROGRM_YMD) AS MIN_DT , MAX(A.PROGRM_YMD) AS MAX_DT FROM SDA510 A JOIN ( SELECT B2.JOB_YMD , B2.OPRTR_ID , B2.TMPR_SN , LISTAGG(B2.INSTR_ENFSN_NO,',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY B2.PCHPRS_YN DESC, B2.INSTR_ENFSN_NO) AS ENFSN_NO , MAX(B2.COMPNO_INSTR_YN) AS COMPNO_INSTR_YN FROM SDA510 B1 /* 엑셀업로드수업일정 */ JOIN SDA511 B2 /* 엑셀업로드보조강사 */ ON B2.JOB_YMD = B1.JOB_YMD AND B2.OPRTR_ID = B1.OPRTR_ID AND B2.TMPR_SN = B1.TMPR_SN WHERE B1.RESRCE_NO = #{RESRCE_NO} GROUP BY B2.JOB_YMD, B2.OPRTR_ID, B2.TMPR_SN ) B ON B.JOB_YMD = A.JOB_YMD AND B.OPRTR_ID = A.OPRTR_ID AND B.TMPR_SN = A.TMPR_SN WHERE A.RESRCE_NO = #{RESRCE_NO} GROUP BY A.PROGRM_NM, A.EDU_PROGRM_SE_CD, A.PROGRM_BGNG_HR, A.PROGRM_END_HR, B.COMPNO_INSTR_YN, B.ENFSN_NO ORDER BY MIN_DT

/* isry.itgcm.crtrinfo.resrce.SrvcResrceMapper.selectEduSchdlExcvHrList(스케쥴적용 실행시간 조회) */
SELECT A.PROGRM_NO , B.LCTRE_SN , D.PROGRM_YMD , D.LCTRE_HR , D.PROGRM_DTL_CN FROM SDA300 A JOIN SDA340 B ON B.PROGRM_NO = A.PROGRM_NO AND B.RESRCE_NO = A.RESRCE_NO AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' JOIN ( SELECT C1.PROGRM_NO , C1.RESRCE_NO , C1.LCTRE_SN , LISTAGG(C1.INSTR_ENFSN_NO,',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY C1.PCHPRS_YN DESC, C1.INSTR_ENFSN_NO) AS ENFSN_NO FROM SDA342 C1 WHERE C1.RESRCE_NO = #{RESRCE_NO} AND C1.DEL_YN = 'N' GROUP BY C1.PROGRM_NO, C1.RESRCE_NO, C1.LCTRE_SN ) C ON C.PROGRM_NO = B.PROGRM_NO AND C.RESRCE_NO = B.RESRCE_NO AND C.LCTRE_SN = B.LCTRE_SN JOIN ( SELECT D1.PROGRM_YMD , D1.PROGRM_NM , D1.EDU_PROGRM_SE_CD , D1.PROGRM_BGNG_HR , D1.PROGRM_END_HR , D1.LCTRE_HR , D1.PROGRM_DTL_CN , LISTAGG(D2.INSTR_ENFSN_NO,',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY D2.PCHPRS_YN DESC, D2.INSTR_ENFSN_NO) AS ENFSN_NO FROM SDA510 D1 /* 엑셀업로드수업일정 */ JOIN SDA511 D2 /* 엑셀업로드보조강사 */ ON D2.JOB_YMD = D1.JOB_YMD AND D2.OPRTR_ID = D1.OPRTR_ID AND D2.TMPR_SN = D1.TMPR_SN WHERE D1.RESRCE_NO = #{RESRCE_NO} GROUP BY D1.JOB_YMD, D1.OPRTR_ID, D1.TMPR_SN, D1.PROGRM_NM, D1.EDU_PROGRM_SE_CD, D1.PROGRM_BGNG_HR, D1.PROGRM_END_HR, D1.PROGRM_YMD, D1.LCTRE_HR, D1.PROGRM_DTL_CN ) D ON D.PROGRM_YMD BETWEEN B.LCTRE_BGNG_YMD AND B.LCTRE_END_YMD AND D.PROGRM_NM = A.PROGRM_TTL_NM AND D.EDU_PROGRM_SE_CD = A.EDU_PROGRM_SE_CD AND D.PROGRM_BGNG_HR = B.PROGRM_BGNG_HR AND D.PROGRM_END_HR = B.PROGRM_END_HR AND D.ENFSN_NO = C.ENFSN_NO WHERE A.RESRCE_NO = #{RESRCE_NO} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N'

/* isry.itgcm.crtrinfo.resrce.SrvcResrceMapper.selectProgrmNo2(프로그램번호 가져오기2) */ SELECT PROGRM_NO AS PROGRM_NO ,LCTRE_SN AS LCTRE_SN FROM SDA340 /* 자원프로그램상세일정 */ WHERE 1=1 AND RESRCE_NO = #{RESRCE_NO} -- 자원번호 AND LCTRE_BGNG_YMD = #{LCTRE_BGNG_YMD}

/* isry.tgcm.crtrinfo.resrce.SrvcResrceMapper.selectIntrList(스케쥴적용 강사 조회) */
SELECT a.PROGRM_NO AS PROGRM_NO , b.LCTRE_SN AS LCTRE_SN , c.INSTR_ENFSN_NO AS INSTR_ENFSN_NO , c.PCHPRS_YN AS PCHPRS_YN , b.COMPNO_INSTR_YN AS COMPNO_INSTR_YN FROM SDA300 a JOIN SDA340 b ON a.PROGRM_NO = b.PROGRM_NO AND a.RESRCE_NO = b.RESRCE_NO AND b.DEL_YN = 'N' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT C.PROGRM_NM , C.EDU_PROGRM_SE_CD , C.PROGRM_BGNG_HR , C.PROGRM_END_HR , C.SUM_HR , C.COMPNO_INSTR_YN , REGEXP_SUBSTR(C.PCHPRS_YN, '[^,]+', 1 , LEVEL) AS PCHPRS_YN , REGEXP_SUBSTR(C.ENFSN_NO, '[^,]+', 1 , LEVEL) AS INSTR_ENFSN_NO , C.MIN_DT AS START_DT , C.MAX_DT AS END_DT FROM ( SELECT A.PROGRM_NM , A.EDU_PROGRM_SE_CD , A.PROGRM_BGNG_HR , A.PROGRM_END_HR , SUM(A.LCTRE_HR) AS SUM_HR , B.COMPNO_INSTR_YN , B.PCHPRS_YN , B.ENFSN_NO , MIN(A.PROGRM_YMD) AS MIN_DT , MAX(A.PROGRM_YMD) AS MAX_DT FROM SDA510 A JOIN ( SELECT B2.JOB_YMD , B2.OPRTR_ID , B2.TMPR_SN , LISTAGG(B2.PCHPRS_YN,',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY B2.PCHPRS_YN DESC, B2.INSTR_ENFSN_NO) AS PCHPRS_YN , LISTAGG(B2.INSTR_ENFSN_NO,',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY B2.PCHPRS_YN DESC, B2.INSTR_ENFSN_NO) AS ENFSN_NO , MAX(B2.COMPNO_INSTR_YN) AS COMPNO_INSTR_YN FROM SDA510 B1 /* 엑셀업로드수업일정 */ JOIN SDA511 B2 /* 엑셀업로드보조강사 */ ON B2.JOB_YMD = B1.JOB_YMD AND B2.OPRTR_ID = B1.OPRTR_ID AND B2.TMPR_SN = B1.TMPR_SN WHERE B1.RESRCE_NO = #{RESRCE_NO} GROUP BY B2.JOB_YMD, B2.OPRTR_ID, B2.TMPR_SN ) B ON B.JOB_YMD = A.JOB_YMD AND B.OPRTR_ID = A.OPRTR_ID AND B.TMPR_SN = A.TMPR_SN WHERE A.RESRCE_NO = #{RESRCE_NO} GROUP BY A.PROGRM_NM , A.EDU_PROGRM_SE_CD , A.PROGRM_BGNG_HR , A.PROGRM_END_HR , B.COMPNO_INSTR_YN , B.PCHPRS_YN , B.ENFSN_NO ) C CONNECT BY LEVEL <= LENGTH(REGEXP_REPLACE(C.ENFSN_NO,'[^,]+',''))+1 ) c ON a.PROGRM_TTL_NM = c.PROGRM_NM AND a.EDU_PROGRM_SE_CD = c.EDU_PROGRM_SE_CD AND b.LCTRE_BGNG_YMD = c.START_DT AND b.LCTRE_END_YMD = c.END_DT AND b.PROGRM_BGNG_HR = c.PROGRM_BGNG_HR AND b.PROGRM_END_HR = c.PROGRM_END_HR WHERE 1 = 1 AND a.RESRCE_NO = #{RESRCE_NO} AND c.INSTR_ENFSN_NO IS NOT NULL AND a.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY b.LCTRE_BGNG_YMD
